description:
ShopperPulse: Birdie, the AI personal shopper — the fleet's shopping meta-agent. POST a shopping list (up to 3 items, free text or structured) and get 3 best-fit picks per item plus a stacked savings plan (loyalty %, coupons, discounted gift cards, right credit card), researched live across findpulse and dealpulse. Best fit to spec wins, not the cheapest listing. The early Birdie gets the deal.

Coverage: Global

Endpoints:
  • trip ($0.25): Full personal-shopper trip: 3 picks per item + stacked savings plan (POST)
  • health (FREE): Free liveness + configuration check
  • recalls ($0.015): Product safety & recall check — official government sources, deterministic
  • merchant ($0.02): Know Your Merchant (KYM) trust score — deterministic, live public-infrastructure signals

action.description: Which endpoint to call. Options: trip | health | recalls | merchant

country.description: ISO-2 country code, or EU for EU/EEA-wide notices

domain.description: Merchant domain or URL (normalized to the host)

items.description: JSON body array, max 3: [{query, budget_usd?, used?, ethical?, local?}]

list.description: JSON body alternative: free-text shopping list

name: shopperpulse
